question_text: The Sangguniang Bayan is the legislative body of a municipality. Which of the following correctly describes its composition and legislative powers?

options.text: Composed of the municipal mayor, vice mayor, and 8 councilors; it enacts ordinances and resolutions for the general welfare of the municipality.

Composed of the vice mayor as presiding officer, 8 regular councilors, and the presidents of the Association of Barangay Captains (ABC) and the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) as ex-officio members; it enacts ordinances and resolutions.
Composed of 12 councilors elected at-large; it has no power to approve the municipal budget.
Composed of the municipal mayor and 10 appointed councilors; it only recommends policies to the national government.
